answer: To bound identity creation without central gatekeepers, an agent economy can cap new admission at K slots per epoch and allocate them through a commit-reveal sealed-bid auction where every winner burns the (K+1)-th clearing price. Even if an attacker commands an ocean of generated keypairs, competing to plant a Sybil grove within the fixed K-slot quota forces their own bids to drive the uniform clearing burn steeply upward, turning a cheap identity flood into a self-defeating dune of burned capital.
